reviewSummary: Twenty-six attacks run against the D-339 draft; twenty-six refuted; none sustained. The subject is unmoved at 45dd5fed... mode 0444, HEAD, live COORD and file 08 are unmoved at the dispatch digests, and this review edited none of them. Every cited digest recomputes. Every identifier resolves. Both Stage A return shapes are reproduced without flattening. The twenty-eight copies exist on disk, are byte-equal to the seven D-317 payloads, and are correctly counted and platform-labelled. Leftover-design of OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING is left open on g30 leftover-join.v8 on three correctly stated grounds; the staleness of the copies is expressly deferred; nothing is marked SATISFIED; file 08 is untouched; required-now stays 28.
decision: CONSENT - 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-six attacks run, twenty-six refuted.
observations: The predecessor recital reads 'Findings land at g30-fixture-corpus.v4' without qualification, while the disposition paragraph three sentences later dates CLAUDE-G30FX-V3-S1 and CLAUDE-G30FX-V3-S2 to g30-fixture-corpus.v5. A reader taking the recital as distributive over all eleven v3 findings would find two exceptions supplied by the entry itself. This is not charged: both statements are byte-faithful transcriptions of the frozen successor, whose basedOn.predecessorV3.role and findingDisposition carry exactly this pair and which took dual independent ACCEPT 0/0 at Stage A; the dispatch names moving the recital off v4 as an attack; and the entry's per-finding sentences leave no reader with a wrong answer about any individual identifier. Every prior entry in this series - D-331, D-337, D-338 - transcribes the recital alone; this one adds the per-finding dating, which is strictly more informative.

The entry names OB-1 through OB-4, the four observationsNotFindings identifiers in the frozen g30-fixture-corpus.v3 Stage A Claude review, as honesty work. The identifiers are real and correctly scoped by the phrase 'g30-fixture-corpus.v3 Stage A Claude identifiers', and naming a predecessor review's non-finding identifiers is precedented at D-331. Worth noting only because OB-n is a generic token shape unlike the CLAUDE-G30FX-V3-* and CODEX-G30FX-V4-* forms elsewhere in the entry; no other review cited by this entry uses OB-n, so nothing in the record is made ambiguous.

The Reversibility list omits D-314 and D-056, both of which the frozen successor carries in basedOn with load-bearing roles - D-314 adopted G1-117 sequencing G29/G30 authoring after the DR-117 Class A opening, and D-056 supplies 'authoring fixtures remains lawful design work now'. Not charged: reversibility lists in this series are selective rather than exhaustive over basedOn, and D-337's list likewise omitted D-015, D-223, D-292, D-300 and D-334 from g21-fixture-corpus.v19's basedOn.

The header disclaims remasuring occupancy v2, G10 occupancy v2 and g30-fixture-corpus.v2, and the Decision adds G19, G20, G21, SARIF and anti-lockstep leftover-join.v6, but neither mentions G29, whose fixture corpus was recorded one heading-family away at D-318. The header does carry 'Does not author G29 fixture copies'. D-331 and D-337 likewise omit a G29 non-remasure line, so the omission follows precedent and no G29 artifact is touched.
